title: Completed RISK DATA SHEET Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed RISK DATA SHEET artifact data payloads (PMO-04.08.05).

risk_identifier_and_title.description: Unique identifier code and descriptive title for the specific high-impact risk.

risk_statement_and_operational_context.description: Comprehensive statement articulating cause, condition, and operational impact.

assigned_risk_owner_and_stakeholders.description: Designated risk owner, action lead, and impacted project stakeholders.

assessed_probability_and_impact_ratings.description: Detailed probability rating and impact breakdown across scope, schedule, and cost.

expected_monetary_value_emv_analysis.description: Quantitative calculation of monetary impact (Probability x Financial Consequence).

schedule_delay_and_critical_path_exposur.description: Projected days of delay on critical path activities if the risk occurs.

root_cause_analysis_details.description: Underlying systemic, technical, or environmental drivers causing the risk.

early_warning_triggers_and_thresholds.description: Identifiable metrics and operational thresholds that trigger risk activation.

primary_mitigation_action_plan.description: Step-by-step preventive measures, action item owners, and completion deadlines.

contingency_and_fallback_response_plan.description: Secondary action plan implemented if primary mitigation fails or risk materializes.

allocated_contingency_budget_and_reserve.description: Specific financial reserve allocation assigned to execute this risk response.
